content.text:
Avi, I found something, but I'm only fairly sure. I'll go over it with you before I call anyone.

**What I decided:** Two of them have the lowest management fee. Each charges "0.56%" of the savings and "0%" on what you put in. One is **הראל** (track number 15040) and the other is **אלטשולר שחם** (track number 14864). All the others charge more, from 0.57% up to 0.67%. If I go ahead it will be Harel, because it's a big name I know. But Altshuler is just as cheap.

**What I looked at, in order:**
- The heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". The button "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" was already lit up, which is good because that's what I was after.
- Under "במה הכסף מושקע" the button "עוקב מדדי מניות 11" was chosen. "Tracks share indices" sounded like what I was told to look for. I didn't touch "עוקב מדד s&p 500", because of the English letters.
- Then I went down the list one company at a time and read only "דמי ניהול מההחיסכון" for each:
  - הראל 0.56
  - מור 0.67
  - אנליסט 0.6
  - מיטב 0.65
  - אלטשולר שחם 0.56
  - הפניקס 0.6
  - מגדל 0.62
  - כלל 0.63
  - מנורה 0.57
  - אינפיניטי 0.65
  - אילון קופות גמל: "עוד לא דווח". So I don't know their fee at all.

**What I skipped:** The ring pictures with "מניות / מט"ח" and their percentages. The returns ("פחות מ־3 שנים", and Meitav's "25.86%"). The "כסף מנוהל" amounts. The question marks. The links at the bottom.

**What I didn't understand:**
- "מט"ח" next to a yellow dot.
- Little rings that are partly filled.
- "פחות מ־3 שנים" where I expected a number.
- The yellow box saying "נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026". It worried me a bit.
- The list isn't ordered by fee. I had to check every company myself to find the cheapest.

**What bothered me:**
- The whole page is dark, with pale grey writing. The small lines, like the one under each company's name, I could barely read even enlarged.
- Every company row repeats the same words: "מסלול אחד מתוך…", "דמי ניהול מההחיסכון: מ־… עד …", "עוקב מדדי מניות". I had to read them again on each row just to find the one number that changes.
- The fee is written twice for each company, once in the grey line and once in the row below it.
- Many numbers on one screen. I was tired by the end of the second screen.
